classified.title: In Re: Fundamental Right To Walk And ... vs Ministry Of Housing And Urban Affairs on 27 July, 2026
classified.reason: Suo motu PIL on fundamental right to walk and footpaths, seeking systemic pedestrian infrastructure relief nationwide.

classified.title: Reliance General Insurance Company Ltd vs Om Parkash on 30 July, 2026
classified.reason: Primarily an insurer's liability appeal, but sets evidentiary precedent on proving driving licence validity (secondary evidence, owner's duty to verify renewal) binding on MACTs/insurers, and issues suggestions to MoRTH and States on licensing awareness, compliance and driving school regulation.

classified.title: Nisha vs Municipal Council Sangrur on 31 July, 2026
classified.reason: Though arising from an individual compensation claim, the judgment issues nationwide systemic suggestions/directions to Centre and all States on stray cattle on roads, compensation mechanisms, tagging and shelters, with copies to all Chief Secretaries.
